businessProblem: Too much reporting, not enough trusted signal for decisions.

productLadder.name: Dashboard Trust Scorecard
productLadder.definition: Free self-assessment that helps buyers identify whether the issue is metric trust, ownership, decision cadence, or operational signal quality.

productLadder.name: Free Fit Check
productLadder.definition: Free 15-minute routing conversation to identify the smallest useful next step.

productLadder.name: Analytics Health Check
productLadder.definition: 1-2 week paid diagnostic that reviews dashboards, metric definitions, data models, reporting processes, pain points, and decision friction to produce a foundation issue map and recommended next step.

productLadder.name: Decision System Reset
productLadder.definition: 4-8 week rebuild of the decision system: decisions, metrics, owners, triggers, cadence, and escalation.

productLadder.name: Fractional Analytics
productLadder.definition: Ongoing senior ownership and governance that maintains and evolves the decision system as priorities shift.

productLadder.name: Intelligence Lab
productLadder.definition: Advanced operational intelligence products, especially the Weekly Operational Intelligence Digest, built after the foundation is trusted.
